description.value: Fox'n Hounds Pub is a full-service neighbourhood pub in Kamloops offering a broad menu of pub classics, burgers, pizzas, and a Sunday brunch alongside a large rotating tap selection that leans heavily on BC craft beers. Alongside its liquor store affiliate (Sahali Liquor Store), it functions as a one-stop food-and-drink destination on the west side of the city. Touring cyclists riding into Kamloops will find a familiar, welcoming pub environment with the option to call ahead for takeout.

address.value: 945 W Columbia St #20, Kamloops, BC V2C 1L5

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website was successfully fetched and confirms an active pub at 945 W Columbia St #20, Kamloops. The homepage prompt 'CALL IN YOUR ORDER!' confirms takeout service. Multiple menu items carry a '(GF)' label (nachos, wings, pork ribs) and the spring rolls are explicitly described as 'VEGETARIAN ROLLS', confirming GF and vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Fox'n Hounds Pub' while website consistently uses 'Fox N Hounds' (no apostrophe, no 'Pub' suffix).

Address discrepancy: OSM address field lacks postal code and abbreviates differently ('945 Columbia Street West') versus website ('945 W Columbia St #20, Kamloops, BC V2C 1L5'); website version used as more complete and current.
Hours discrepancy between OSM tags and website: OSM lists Wednesday close at 21:00 (9 pm) while website says 11 pm; OSM lists Sunday open at 11:00 while website shows Sunday brunch starting at 10 am.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active full-service pub in Kamloops with confirmed takeout, GF and vegetarian menu options, and a current web presence — a useful food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists entering or passing through the city.
